Erin — quick technical note and draft test matrix below. I attached a spreadsheet stub (pivotscale-test-plan.xlsx) with the scenarios.

Summary of recommended baseline config:
- Dedicated pool: 2x A10G-equivalent GPUs (we can map to your cloud SKU)
- Model: rwl-13b-quant (recommended) for throughput profile; fallback: rwl-7b-quant for constrained runs
- Network: outbound to api.redwoodinference.com (443), allowlist IPs in network-allowlist.txt (attached)
- Batching: initial batch size 8, adapt after warm-up
- KV cache: expect warm cache to cut token CPU by ~30% for multi-turn agents

Draft test matrix (high level):
- Latency SLAs: p50/p95/p99 under sustained 50 rps and 200 rps spikes
- Throughput: tokens/sec measured across 10-minute windows
- Stability: 12-hour soak at 50 rps with intermittent burst to 300 rps
- Failover: simulate primary GPU OOM and validate automatic routing to fallback variant

Attachments included: network-allowlist.txt, pivotscale-test-plan.xlsx, redwood-pivotscale-reference-design.pdf

Let me know if you want us to run the first pass of the soak tests from our Dedicated environment and share logs.

-Karthik
